task_description.overview: Convert seismic waveform data into supported ASCII formats using ObsPy's write() method on a Stream object.
steps: Load seismic waveform data from the specified input URL or file using obspy.read().
Select one of the supported ASCII formats (SLIST, TSPAIR, SH_ASC).
Use stream.write(output_path, format=format_name) to export the data.
Verify the generated ASCII file for correct header and data lines.

task_definition.agent_prompt: Read the seismic waveform from {seismic_waveform_path} using ObsPy, then export it to ASCII format '{format}' at {ascii_file} using the Stream.write() method. Ensure the output file contains the correct header and sample data.
